items.prompt:
Aerobic respiration uses
A) oxygen
B) no oxygen
C) only light
D) only salt

Anaerobic respiration occurs
A) with oxygen
B) without oxygen
C) only in sunlight
D) only in water

Which releases more energy?
A) Aerobic respiration
B) Anaerobic respiration
C) They are equal
D) Neither releases energy

Anaerobic respiration in muscles produces
A) lactic acid
B) pure oxygen
C) glucose
D) sunlight

Anaerobic respiration releases less energy because glucose is broken down
A) completely
B) only partly
C) into oxygen
D) into light

In yeast fermentation, what gas makes bread rise?
A) Carbon dioxide
B) Oxygen
C) Nitrogen
D) Helium

steps: Carbon dioxide from fermentation makes bread rise.

items.prompt:
The best explanation for why aerobic conditions release more energy is that
A) glucose is broken down completely with oxygen, releasing more stored energy
B) oxygen adds energy from nothing
C) anaerobic uses more oxygen
D) energy is created
items.answer: A) glucose is broken down completely with oxygen, releasing more stored energy

items.prompt:
During both aerobic and anaerobic respiration, matter
A) cycles as atoms are rearranged into new molecules
B) is destroyed
C) is created
D) disappears
items.answer: A) cycles as atoms are rearranged into new molecules

steps: Atoms move into new molecules in both.
